facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 71°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left Summit Lake (5,610 ft) and Diamond Lake (5,280 ft) 29 to 38 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Summit Lake
evidence.detail: left May 19; earlier seasons: June 26 (2023), June 23 (2024), June 30 (2025)

evidence.name: Diamond Lake
evidence.detail: left April 3; earlier seasons: May 13 (2023), April 18 (2024), May 2 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Summit Lake (5,610 ft) and Diamond Lake (5,280 ft).

evidence.name: Summit Lake
evidence.detail: 12.5 in on April 22; earlier seasons: 47.6 in (2023), 42.0 in (2024), 51.6 in (2025)

evidence.name: Diamond Lake
evidence.detail: 0.8 in on April 15; earlier seasons: 20.9 in (2023), 8.1 in (2024), 27.1 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 8 and May 27, carried from the melt-out dates at Summit Lake (5,610 ft) and Diamond Lake (5,280 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Summit Lake
evidence.detail: melted out May 19, 207 ft below the pass; points to April 30 to June 15

evidence.name: Diamond Lake
evidence.detail: melted out April 3, 537 ft below the pass; points to March 18 to May 8
